articles.summary: Honda Global | Hunter Lawrence (age 27, Australia) of Honda HRC Progressive has claimed his first title in the premier 450MX (450 class) of the 2026 AMA Pro Motocross Championship.
articles.title: ＜AMA Pro Motocross Championship＞ Hunter Lawrence Claims His First 450 Class Title

articles.summary: Honda Global | Honda Motor Co., Ltd. today announced a summary of automobile production, Japan domestic sales, and export results for the month of July 2026.
articles.title: Production, Sales and Export Results for July, 2026

articles.summary: Honda Global | Nissan Motor Co., Ltd. and Honda Motor Co., Ltd. have entered into a joint development agreement to standardize multiple electronic control units (ECUs) that form the core of next-generation software-defined vehicles (SDVs), along with the in-vehicle operating system and key parts of the middleware, and vehicle control software that run on these ECUs.
articles.title: Nissan and Honda Conclude Joint Development Agreement to Standardize ECUs and Software for Next-Generation SDVs
